items.title: Zelenskyy urges support for new US sanctions on Russia after Trump puts them on hold
items.description: Zelenskyy described the move as unfortunate, adding it would encourage Russia to continue its assault. Trump told Congress that the pause was in the national interest but gave no further details.

items.title: Russia wants blackout in Ukraine as winter comes — Zelenskyy
items.description: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy says Russia is trying to cut electricity and heating to civilians ahead of winter. He also called the US president's waiver of new sanctions on Moscow a boost for Vladimir Putin.

items.title: War in Ukraine: Europe stands united behind Kyiv but must revisit how to finance its support
items.description: Invited to the European leaders' summit in Brussels on Friday, Volodymyr Zelensky, weakened by what he called the 'betrayal' of Donald Trump, asked his allies for an additional €70 billion in aid for the year 2027.

items.title: Kremlin ‘Fully Agrees’ With Trump’s Zelensky Criticism
items.description: Putin continues to demand that Kyiv cede full control of the Donetsk region as a prerequisite for any ceasefire agreement, a condition Ukraine rejects.

items.title: Zelenskyy Says US Diesel Deal Will Put Money 'Straight Into Putin's Pocket'
items.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that his Russian counterpart, Vladimir Putin, has no interest in peace talks and criticized a US deal with Moscow on diesel exports, saying it will hand more money to Moscow to fund its war against his country.
